name: भारतीय रेलवे समय-सारिणी (Indian Railway Timetable — per-stop schedule)
title: भारतीय रेलवे समय-सारिणी (Indian Railway Timetable — per-stop schedule)
description: Per-stop timetable rows for every Indian Railways train: each record gives the stop sequence number, station code/name, arrival and departure times (HH:MM:SS, 24-hour), and cumulative distance in km from the train's source station. Spans 11,112 unique trains across 8,148 unique stations on 4,895 distinct source->destination route pairs. Trains carry between 1 and 118 stops (mean 16.7); the longest single train run reaches 4,260 km from source. Arrival times are present for 184,117 of 186,119 rows (98.9%) and departure times for 184,150 (98.9%); 00:00:00 sentinels at source-arrival and destination-departure rows are normalised to null. 5 upstream CSV-shifted corrupt rows (train_no=='K' with time strings in name/seq slots) were filtered for data integrity. Upstream snapshot dated 2017-12-22; underlying data sourced from data.gov.in (Govt. of India open data platform). Suitable for route planning, station connectivity graphs, distance/travel-time analysis, and historical-baseline comparison against current Indian Railways schedules.
